name: Let's Play Minecraft
description: Achievement Hunter takes on the hardest tests in the search for power, fame, and the coveted Tower of Pimps: a gold monolith that grants the winner special powers like arrogance and hatred from coworkers. Welcome to...Achievement City.

videos.title: Let's Play Minecraft with Geoff, Jack, Michael, Gavin and Ray
videos.overview: Achievement Hunter joins together to build a house and survive the night in their very first Let's Play of Minecraft.

videos.title: Episode 2 - On A Rail!
videos.overview: The lads use their teamwork and building skills to try to obtain the "On A Rail" achievement.

videos.title: Episode 3 - Plan G
videos.overview: Gavin and Geoff give the lads a tour of the new Achievement City, with an explosive ending.

videos.title: Episode 4 - Race to Bedrock!
videos.overview: The lads hold a competition to see who can reach bedrock first by digging straight down.

videos.title: Episode 5 - The Hunt For Diamonds
videos.overview: The lads compete in a race to see who can make a diamond pickaxe first.

videos.title: Episode 6 - Enter the Nether Part 1
videos.overview: The lads compete in a race to see who can step into the Nether first.

videos.title: Episode 7 - Enter the Nether Part 2
videos.overview: The conclusion of the race to enter the Nether.

videos.title: Episode 8 - Build a Tower Part 1
videos.overview: The lads hold a contest to see who can be the first to build a Tower of Pimps.

videos.title: Episode 9 - Build a Tower Part 2
videos.overview: The conclusion of the race to build a Tower of Pimps.

videos.title: Episode 10 - Wipeout Part 1
videos.overview: Jack, Michael, and Ray compete for the fastest time in a Wipeout course.

videos.title: Episode 11 - Wipeout Part 2
videos.overview: Jack, Michael, and Ray return for Round 2 of the Wipeout course.

videos.title: Episode 12 - Last Man Standing
videos.overview: Jack, Michael, and Ray compete in an underground survival game.

videos.title: Episode 13 - Find the Tower Part 1
videos.overview: Jack, Gavin, Michael, and Ray compete in a race to retrieve the stolen Tower of Pimps.

videos.title: Episode 14 - Find the Tower Part 2
videos.overview: The conclusion of the search for the stolen Tower of Pimps.

videos.title: Episode 15 - Tower of Geoff Part 1
videos.overview: Geoff has stolen the Tower of Pimps and the lads must retrieve it from him.

videos.title: Episode 16 - Tower of Geoff Part 2
videos.overview: Ray, Gavin, Jack, and Michael continue their search for Geoff and the Tower of Pimps.

videos.title: Episode 17 - Tower of Geoff Part 3
videos.overview: The conclusion of the hunt for Geoff and the Tower of Pimps.

videos.title: Episode 18 - Mineball
videos.overview: The lads split into teams and face off against each other in a Minecraft football game.

videos.title: Episode 19 - Altar of Pimps
videos.overview: The lads compete in a race to build the Tower of Pimps on top of the Altar of Pimps.

videos.title: Episode 20 - The Labyrinth
videos.overview: The Achievement Hunters compete in a race to navigate a dark labyrinth and find the Tower of Pimps.

videos.title: Episode 21 - Stronghold Hunting in 1.8!
videos.overview: The Achievement Hunters explore the new 1.8 update and begin a quest to find a stronghold.

videos.title: Episode 22 - Grifball
videos.overview: The lads split into teams again and face off against each other in a Grifball game.

videos.title: Episode 23 - Hunger Games
videos.overview: The Achievement Hunters must put their survival skills to the test as they compete in the Hunger Games.

videos.title: Episode 24 - Capture the Tower!
videos.overview: The lads are once again split into teams as they play a game of Capture the Flag.

videos.title: Episode 25 - Stronghold Hunting Part 2
videos.overview: The Achievement Hunters continue their quest to find a stronghold.

videos.title: Episode 26 - Underground Farmers
videos.overview: The lads set up a base in an underground library and try to grow a watermelon.

videos.title: Episode 27 - Mounted Combat
videos.overview: The lads compete in a combat game where they must ride pigs and survive.

videos.title: Episode 28 - Fishing Rodeo and Jamboree
videos.overview: The Achievement Hunters are joined by Caleb as they host their first ever Fishing Rodeo and Jamboree at Achievement Hunter Camp, where the goal is to catch the most fish within 30 minutes.

videos.title: Episode 29 - The Walls
videos.overview: The lads are once again joined by Caleb as they split into teams and play a game of last team standing.

videos.title: Episode 30 - 1.9 Update
videos.overview: The lads explore the new 1.9 update and try to find a Mooshroom.

videos.title: Episode 31 - Wool Collecting Part 1
videos.overview: The Achievement Hunters compete in a race to create all 16 colors of wool.
